summary: Apply DMAIC, SIPOC and project data to analyze defects and plan controls. Explore this five-day foundation course.
lede: Six Sigma gives project managers, coordinators and process improvement leads a structured way to reduce variation and defects in project work. The course covers scoping improvement with DMAIC and SIPOC, setting baselines from basic process data, analyzing causes with Pareto charts and fishbone diagrams, and planning improvement actions and controls.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who manage or support projects where delays, defects, handoff failures or rework need a structured, data-informed response. It connects Six Sigma improvement methods with practical project responsibilities such as scope control, team coordination and progress reporting.
prerequisites: No specific prerequisite was provided in the course brief. The foundation-level course introduces Six Sigma and DMAIC terminology.
